name: wordpress-content
description: Manage authorized WordPress pages, posts, design tokens, images, media, videos, and other user-facing content without infrastructure changes.

interface.shortDescription: Manage WordPress content and user-facing design safely.
interface.longDescription: A content-only WordPress workflow for pages, posts, user-facing design systems and tokens, images, media, videos, authenticated REST or administrator UI work, and rendered verification. It uses a site-scoped WordPress Application Password reference from an approved local secret store and never changes hosting, filesystems, plugins, or infrastructure-as-code.
defaultPrompt: Onboard WordPress Content with a site-scoped Application Password reference, read-only.
Inspect my WordPress pages, posts, media, and design system without changing infrastructure.
Update this WordPress page or media asset and verify the user-facing result.
